summary.en-US: Glass, backgrounds, and a quieter workspace across eight AI websites. Built for Firefox.

description.en-US: Bring glass, image and video backgrounds, and shared preferences to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, and Hugging Face. Keep each website's familiar layout while adjusting transparency, themes, and fonts. Focus mode, history blur, text masking, message queues, and native model preferences appear where supported. Preferences use browser storage. Uploaded backgrounds stay local.

release_notes.en-US: The first Aurora Universal release expands Aurora beyond ChatGPT to eight AI websites. Includes shared appearance and privacy settings, local image and video backgrounds, bundled fonts, message queues, and native model preferences where supported. Universal begins at 1.0.0 following the earlier 1.8 development builds.

version.approval_notes: AGPL-3.0-only extension with readable JavaScript and CSS. No build-time transpilation, analytics, or remote executable code. unlimitedStorage supports local user-selected backgrounds within a 15 MB file limit. Host access applies site-specific appearance and features. License and third-party notices are included. Aurora Universal begins at 1.0.0 with the new Gecko ID aurora-universal@pigeonlabs. It replaces the earlier ChatGPT-only project but uses a separate listing. Remote wallpaper loads directly from its provider.
